misses.why: PaSa (He et al 2025). The crawler that alternates search and expand-citations actions; the reference design for why graph traversal beats single-query search.
RollingEval (Sahu et al 2026). Shows bibliography expansion lifting recall from under 20 % to over 80 %, and that human citation lists are a weak ground truth.
ScholarQuest (Pan et al 2026). The scope-control failure — agents treat exclusions as positive keywords — and the off-target-exploration failure mode.
LitSearch (Ajith et al 2024). The retrieval benchmark the later agentic systems report against; you cannot read their numbers without it.
OpenScholar (Asai et al 2024). Retrieval-augmented synthesis over the literature with an open datastore — the main open counterpoint to the closed agentic systems.
LitLLM (Agarwal et al 2024). The rerank-after-retrieve toolkit; the earliest of these to separate retrieval from reranking as distinct stages.
